method.ownerDecision: The study owner explicitly approved GPT-5 mini inclusion for this separate 50-condition non-counted pilot; see docs/ACI-P1-LIVE-INJECTION-50-OWNER-APPROVAL.md.
method.institutionalReviewDetermination: not_recorded; outputs remain non-counted technical-pilot observations and are not thesis results unless institution requirements are separately satisfied.
